title: Adverb slot: clearly
instructions: Choose the word-family form that makes the complete sentence grammatical and meaningful.

parts.prompt: The technician explained the safety steps ___, so every volunteer knew what to do.

choice_rationales.A: Clear is normally an adjective here, but the slot modifies how the technician explained.
choice_rationales.B: Clearly is the adverb that modifies the verb explained and matches the result in the sentence.
choice_rationales.C: Clarity is a noun and cannot directly modify explained in this frame.
choice_rationales.D: Clarify is a verb, but the sentence already has the finite verb explained.

parts.hint: The missing word tells how the action ‘explained’ happened.
parts.correct_explanation: An adverb modifies the action, so ‘explained the safety steps clearly’ is grammatical and meaningful.
